conditions.notes: ASM-0002: git commits on main can serve as F_n, PRs as candidates, independent review-and-merge as acceptance, without distorting the design's intent. OBS-0014 does not refute the substrate choice; it challenges the 'without distorting' clause as currently practiced. Direct non-merge commits on main create F_n labels with no acceptance map applied; merged PRs can land elements that remain status:open, so merge≠acceptance of content status; committed chronicle lag means the inspectable projection of F_n is not the sequence git actually has. The assumption can hold as design intent and still be strained as operational description. Challenge severity: moderate — repairable by rule clarification and projection hygiene, not a call to abandon git.
